bagPolicy.summary: Kauffman Stadium enforces a clear bag policy to ensure fan safety and expedite entry. Approved bags include clear bags up to 12” x 6” x 12” and small clutches no larger than 6.5” x 4.5”.
allowed: Clear Bags (Plastic, vinyl or PVC) up to 12” x 6” x 12”
Small Clutch Bags/Wallets no larger than 6.5” x 4.5”
Seat cushions without pockets, zippers or concealable areas up to 18” wide
prohibited: Luggage, computer bags, camera bags, briefcases, fanny packs, cinch bags
bagPolicy.note: Medical bags and diaper bags are exceptions.

parking.note: Kauffman Stadium is part of the Truman Sports Complex east of Kansas City, with large on-site surface lots accessed off I-70. General parking is sold prepaid or at the gate (cashless) and prices rise for premium games. Tailgating is permitted in designated areas.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Kauffman Stadium's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Kauffman Stadium offers a variety of food and beverage options including classic comfort foods with a modern twist, elevated ballpark classics, and hearty eats. Highlights include specialty items like Bacon Wrapped Hot Dogs, Pastrami Fry, and a variety of local and popular beers.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Kauffman Stadium, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: There is no re-entry permitted for any event held at Kauffman Stadium.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Information regarding Season Tickets can be obtained by contacting the box office at (623) 222-2222 or by visiting the Surprise Stadium ticket office located at the Main Centerfield entrance. Box office hours are the following : Game day ticket office hours are 9 a.m. – 3 p.m.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Post-Game: Enter through Gate 1 and look for the designated Traffic Row in the middle of Lot A.
